description: This file defines the IStreamFailureHandler interface, which specifies methods and properties for handling stream failure scenarios in Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling stream failures, including methods for reacting to delivery and subscription failures, and a property indicating if subscriptions should fault on error.

methods.name: ShouldFaultSubsriptionOnError
methods.description: A property indicating whether the subscription should fault when an error occurs.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Method called when all measures to deliver an event to a consumer have been exhausted, indicating a delivery failure.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Method called when establishing a subscription has failed.
